descriptor.scene: One young woman, Maya, has just stepped into a long museum hall and stands small near the entrance, taking it in. The hall is grand and warm and hushed: honey wood floor, cream plaster walls, and along both walls a receding row of doors hung like paintings, each in a simple wooden frame with a soft spotlight from above and a low velvet rope on brass stanchions in front. The plaques beside the far doors are too small and too distant to read. Morning light falls from high windows. Keep the lower right of the frame calm and open floor.
descriptor._caption: There is a hall where they keep the doors. Every company you have ever heard of walked in through one of them.
